lines.zh: 我坐久了，站起来挪两步。
lines.en: After sitting so long, I stand and shuffle two steps.
I walk slowly around the display.

lines.zh: 僵硬的腿先动，身体才跟上。
lines.en: The stiff legs move first, then the body.

lines.zh: 我在这块地板上走了几圈。
lines.en: I do a few rounds on this floor.

lines.zh: 我把坐的位置让出来，又回去。
lines.en: I leave my seat, then return to it.
My steps are heavy and slow.
I walk to the alcove and brace on the wall.
The steel frame under the fabric ticks.

lines.zh: 白天走动，是为了不僵死。
lines.en: I walk by day so I don't seize up.
I follow the baseboard to the door.
I look at the door and walk back.
My step drags a line in the dust.

lines.zh: 我挪到窗下，那儿有点光。
lines.en: I shift under the window where there's light.
I turn and lower myself back down.
I walk carefully, afraid of falling apart.
I go from my spot to the stage's edge.
I sit without moving.

lines.zh: 这个姿势已经摆了很多年。
lines.en: I've held this pose for many years.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我肩上，我不弹。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder; I don't brush it.
Visitors come and I stay like this.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵垂着，遮住一半眼。
lines.en: My ear droops, hiding half an eye.
The showroom is quiet by day.

lines.zh: 我听见墙里的水管在响。
lines.en: I hear the pipes in the wall.
Wires run through my body.

lines.zh: 我不需要闭眼，也不需要睁。
lines.en: I need neither to close my eyes nor open them.
That chair was left for me.

lines.zh: 我保持微笑，虽然布裂了。
lines.en: I keep smiling, though the fabric splits.
The light outside shifts inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我在想今晚该走哪条走廊。
lines.en: I'm thinking which corridor to take tonight.
Sitting so long, my joints have rusted.
There are children's voices in the corridor.
They don't know who I am.
Come to see the exhibit?
I sit. You look.
Does this face frighten you?
I don't chase people by day.

lines.zh: 你走近一点，看得更清楚。
lines.en: Come closer for a better look.

lines.zh: 白天我坐在这儿，等灯灭。
lines.en: By day I sit here and wait for lights out.
This suit used to be handsome.
The lights are on. You're safe.

lines.zh: 你手上的票根，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the ticket in your hand.
I remember every guest.
Stay a moment longer.
The chair rocks.
A new tear in the fabric.
I slowly right myself.
The frame thuds once.
You struck an old thing.
I make no sound, only lower my head.
I remember that clearly.
Dust gets into my eye.
I sit still and wait for you to go.
I don't eat. I don't need to.
Take that farther away.
There's no tongue in my mouth.
That means nothing to a steel frame.
You think you can placate me?
Don't reach so close.
All I need is power.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连声响都没有。
lines.en: That makes no sound at all.
You're flattering a display piece.
I sit and watch you try.
Set it down; I still won't take it.
Keep it, guest.
That amuses me.
Off you go. Don't waste it.
You bump me and the chair creaks.
I'm seated. I won't be shifted.
I won't stand, so I won't step aside.
You brush the fabric on my shoulder.
My knee knocks against your leg.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我往前倾了一下。
lines.en: The knock tips me forward.

lines.zh: 灰尘从我的衣服缝里飞出来。
lines.en: Dust flies from my seams.

lines.zh: 坐下的时候，我不喜欢被人碰。
lines.en: I dislike being touched while seated.
Step back and I'll forget it.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我可能站起来。
lines.en: Bump me once more and I may stand.
Another one is in the showroom too.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一个展台坐着。
lines.en: We sit a display apart.
Its head tilts worse than mine.
Neither of us needs to speak.

lines.zh: 它的布手套破了三个洞。
lines.en: Its fabric glove has three holes.
We pass the daylight together.

lines.zh: 关灯以后，我们各自起身。
lines.en: After lights out, we each rise.
It leaves first, without a sound.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我们中间的地上。
lines.en: Dust settles on the floor between us.
Tomorrow we'll sit back down.

lines.zh: 我坐着，伸手把它捞起来。
lines.en: Seated, I reach out and hook it over.
It rolled beside my chair.
I pinch it up and set it on my knee.
I'll keep this cloth for patching.
One finger is enough to hook it.
The pearl glints in the dust.
I push it into the seat's gap.
Seated, I still see the floor.
Done, I sit straight again.
I only meant to sit.
You've made this complicated.

lines.zh: 展示位上的我，终于转了头。
lines.en: From the display, I finally turn my head.
Not today. We'll speak at night.
You've backed to the door. I saw.
My fingers tap the armrest.
You believe I can strike while seated?
Under all this fabric is iron.

lines.zh: 你别以为坐着就没威胁。
lines.en: Don't think sitting makes me harmless.
The door is open. Run.
You went behind the display.

lines.zh: 我坐着也能看见你的影。
lines.en: Seated, I can still see your shadow.
You touched the lock. I heard.
By day I only watch.
I've memorized that face.
My chair faces your way the whole time.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后面，太窄了。
lines.en: Behind that pillar? Too narrow.
If I stay still, you won't run.
When the lights go out, I rise.
Even seated, I strike back.
I reach out an arm and get you.
My strength comes from steel.
That put you three steps back.

lines.zh: 椅子被我一撑，挪了半尺。
lines.en: The chair slides half a foot as I push.
The fabric tears; iron shows.
Your flashlight rolls away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，你该跑了。
lines.en: I rise slowly. You should run.
I never hurry.
I was placed here to sit.
The showroom opens and I'm here.
Light falls; I don't blink.
The chair is a bit cold.
I'm used to this spot.
Someone pushed the door open.
First the dust settles, then me.
My head rests against my shoulder.
There are voices outside the door.
I remember this corridor.
Flame climbs the fabric.
The chair tips and I land on the floor.

lines.zh: 水进到电路里，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Water reaches my circuits; I jerk.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从椅子上掀下去。
lines.en: The blast throws me off the chair.
A round lodges in my shoulder.
Light scrambles my circuits.
Unplugged, I grow slower and slower.
The strike runs along my frame.

lines.zh: 我坐着的椅子先不见了。
lines.en: The chair vanishes first.
